name: Bosch Quantum Sensing
description: Bosch Quantum Sensing is a German quantum sensing company developing quantum sensors using diamond nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers. Established as a joint venture between Bosch and Element Six, the company focuses on quantum magnetometry and sensing solutions for automotive, industrial, and biomedical applications.

products.name: Diamond NV-Center Quantum Sensors
products.description: Quantum magnetometry sensors using nitrogen-vacancy centers for automotive, industrial, and biomedical use

highlights: Joint venture between Bosch and Element Six (De Beers Group)
Backed by Bosch's global industrial manufacturing and distribution network
Targets automotive, industrial, and biomedical quantum sensing applications

news.title: Bosch and Element Six Form Joint Venture to Scale Quantum Sensing Technologies
news.excerpt: Bosch has formed a joint venture with Element Six to commercialize quantum sensors, with Bosch leading operations and Element Six holding a 25% stake.

news.title: Bosch, Element Six aim for chip-scale diamond quantum sensor
news.excerpt: Bosch is spinning out its quantum sensor startup into a joint venture with synthetic diamond maker Element Six to make chip-scale devices.
